title: NEW MSFS PC Aircraft This Week! 🚀 Speedboat 35ft + PC‑24 Ultimate Liveries (Marketplace Update)
description:
MSFS Marketplace Update April 11, 2026: NEW Speedboat & PC-24 Liveries!
Looking for the latest Microsoft Flight Simulator Marketplace Update? This week’s MSFS April 2026 update brings a unique Speedboat 35ft by Rodrigo Moraes and the PC24 Ultimate Liveries pack! We dive into the newest MSFS PC marketplace update to show you the best new aircraft and MSFS addon releases.

✈️ New aircrafts added this week (PC)
The following aircrafts were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🛫 Rodrigo Moraes: Speedboat 35ft (A fun and unique watercraft experience for MSFS pilots looking to explore beyond traditional aircraft!)

🎨 New Liveries added this week (PC)
The following liveries were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🎨 2PILOT: PC24 ULTIMATE LIVERIES (New livery pack for the popular PC‑24 business jet – currently on sale!)

If you want more MSFS 2020 marketplace update news and MSFS 2020 new addons, make sure to SUBSCRIBE and hit the bell! 🔔
